criteria: Twenty individually source-bound imports on five unchanged owned render helpers. Actual authenticated current declarations and resolved calls supplement retained runtime evidence; this is not complete legacy component, native/packed, consumer-floor or independent audit acceptance. reviews.decision: The autocomplete helper imports the public AfterRenderRef interface as a type only. Its single nullable local registration is assigned from afterNextRender and its public zero-argument destroy method cancels that registration on observable teardown; the application and supplied injector are not destroyed. Whole authenticated 21.x/main minimum declarations resolve the interface and cancellation signature without deprecated, experimental or internal tags, and the type import is erased from emitted JavaScript. The unchanged family replay receipts cover cancellation and owner destruction with genuine current application callbacks. This dependency judgment does not certify actual legacy instances/node DI, native paint, packed artifacts or complete consumer floors.

The autocomplete helper uses the stable public ApplicationRef class as a lookup token in get(ApplicationRef, null), with no direct application creation, destruction or application-member access. A missing application preserves the manual historical zone route; an existing application permits afterNextRender registration using the supplied injector. Complete minimum declarations authenticate the public token export and compile the actual helper; prior source-bound family receipts execute the current application path and manual fallback. ApplicationRef is not repurposed as an owned render-registration handle. This closes this token/guard use, with actual legacy factories/node DI, native/packed and complete floor qualification still separate.
